title: Model-Based Control of a Tendon-Driven Continuum Arm
summary: A multi-segment tendon-driven continuum manipulator is modeled with Cosserat-rod theory and controlled with a robust nonlinear controller for accurate tip tracking under external loads.
keywords: Continuum robot; Cosserat rod; Robust control

title: Pneumatic Soft Gripper for Delicate Products
summary: Design, fabrication and closed-loop pressure control of a silicone soft gripper able to grasp fragile objects such as flowers and fruit without damage.
supervisor: Dr. Masoud Gohari-Manesh; Dr. Ali Koochi

title: Real-Time Simulation of Soft Actuators
summary: A fast simulation pipeline for soft actuators that couples finite-element models with reduced-order models for controller design and testing.

title: Aerial Continuum Manipulation
summary: Dynamics and control of a multirotor drone carrying a lightweight continuum arm, including coupling effects between the flying base and the flexible manipulator.
keywords: Aerial manipulation; Continuum arm; Coupled dynamics
